Package com.workshop.mcp.spec

Class JsonRpcMessageDeserializer

java.lang.Object
com.workshop.mcp.spec.JsonRpcMessageDeserializer
public class JsonRpcMessageDeserializer extends Object
Deserializer for JSON-RPC messages in the MCP (Model Context Protocol) system.

This class provides functionality to deserialize JSON strings into appropriate JSON-RPC message types based on their structure. It handles the polymorphic nature of JSON-RPC messages by examining the presence of specific fields to determine the correct message type.

The deserializer supports the following message types:

  • JsonRpcRequest - Messages with "method" and "id" fields
  • JsonRpcNotification - Messages with "method" but no "id" field
  • JsonRpcResponse - Messages with a "result" field
  • JsonRpcErrorResponse - Messages with an "error" field
  • Unknown - Messages that don't match any known pattern
Since:
1.0

  • Method Details

    • deserialize

      public Object deserialize(String json)
      Deserializes a JSON string into the appropriate JSON-RPC message type.

      This method examines the structure of the JSON to determine the correct message type:

      • If the JSON contains "method" and "id", it's a JsonRpcRequest
      • If the JSON contains "method" without "id", it's a JsonRpcNotification
      • If the JSON contains "result", it's a JsonRpcResponse
      • If the JSON contains "error", it's a JsonRpcErrorResponse
      • Otherwise, it's wrapped in an Unknown object
      Parameters:
      json - the JSON string to deserialize
      Returns:
      the deserialized message object, or Unknown if the format is unrecognized
      Throws:
      com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException - if the JSON is malformed
      IllegalStateException - if the JSON string is not a valid JSON object

    • deserializeParams

      public <T> T deserializeParams(JsonRpcRequest request, Class<T> paramsClass)
      Deserializes the params field of a JSON-RPC request into a specific type.

      This method is useful for converting the generic params Map from a JsonRpcRequest into a strongly-typed parameter object specific to the method being called.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type to deserialize the params into
      Parameters:
      request - the JSON-RPC request containing the params to deserialize
      paramsClass - the class of the params type
      Returns:
      the deserialized params object
      Throws:
      com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException - if the params cannot be deserialized to the specified type

    • convert

      public <T> T convert(Object value, Class<T> type)
      Converts an already-parsed JSON value into a specific type.

      Needed for the answers in params.inputResponses: they arrive as a map of raw JSON values keyed by the question they answer, so each is converted once the caller knows which type it expects.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the target type
      Parameters:
      value - the parsed JSON value, may be null
      type - the class to convert into
      Returns:
      the converted value, or null when there was nothing to convert

    • deserializeEnvelope

      public RequestEnvelope deserializeEnvelope(JsonRpcRequest request)
      Extracts the stateless lifecycle envelope from a request's params._meta.

      The envelope keys are namespaced identifiers containing slashes and dots, which are not valid Java identifiers, so they cannot be mapped by a record's component names the way ordinary params are. They are read out of the JSON tree by name instead.

      A request with no params, non-object params, or no _meta yields an envelope whose fields are all null, which RequestEnvelope.isComplete() reports as incomplete.

      Parameters:
      request - the request to inspect
      Returns:
      the envelope, never null
